theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Euclid n → ℝ) (y : Euclid n) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ContinuousOn f (closedBall y ρ) → ∫ z in ball y ρ, f z = (volume (ball y ρ)).toReal * f y → f y ^ 2 * (volume (ball y ρ)).toReal ≤ ∫ z in ball y ρ, f z ^ 2
